main: Hits the 7 targets with the least HP. Only damages enemy targets. Allied targets are healed on a heads hit. Applies {status:Combustion} on tails hit regardless of target. Very low power.
{status:GainSinStockAdder} allows allies to generate more E.G.O resources but is very inconsistent.

Threadspin V: The main effects have been made much stronger and more consistent. His healing has been changed from Heads Hit to On Hit and goes up to 20% and he gains some SP healing. His {st:GainSinStockAdder} and {st:Agility} have been moved from Tails Hit to Attack End and On Hit.
other: Threadspin V: His passive now gives him additional SP or damage support when using {st:Combustion} skills.

passiveList.desc:
On Tails Hit, inflict 1 [Combustion] if target is an enemy

When using Base Attack Skills that inflict [Combustion] Potency or Count against enemies,

- For Plus Coin Skills:
· At lower than 40 SP, heal 4 SP
· At 40 or higher SP, deal +10% damage

- For Minus Coin Skills:
· At higher than -25 SP, lose 4 SP (this effect cannot reduce this unit's SP below -40)
· At -25 or lower SP, deal +10% damage
